title: Backbone Cyclization and Dimerization of LL-37-Derived Peptides Enhance Antimicrobial Activity and Proteolytic Stability.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (92.31%) to retro-FK13 K: 42%, R: 33%, I: 17%. Activity: active against E. coli (MIC 5 uM), P. aeruginosa (MIC 10 uM), S. aureus (MIC 10 uM), and C. albicans (MIC 5 uM). Warning: Nonstandard assays. Structure: like retroFK-13, retroKR-12 is also helical determined by NMR. You can rotate, zoom, and view the 3D structure here in the PDB.
title: Backbone Cyclization and Dimerization of LL-37-Derived Peptides Enhance Antimicrobial Activity and Proteolytic Stability.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (93.75%) to cd3 K: 13%, R: 20%, I=G: 13%. Activity: active against E. coli (MIC 5 uM), P. aeruginosa (MIC 10 uM), S. aureus (MIC 10 uM), and C. albicans (MIC 5 uM). Warning: Nonstandard assays. SAR: the linear form of this peptide has activity similar to the cyclic form. In vitro toxicity: human RBC, HC50 >40 uM. Peptide stability: over 50% remaining in 25% serum after 6 h. Structure: random coil in buffer and helical in lysophosphatidylglycerol.
title: Backbone Cyclization and Dimerization of LL-37-Derived Peptides Enhance Antimicrobial Activity and Proteolytic Stability.
